title: AI Innovation Challenge: Agentic Workflows
description: Build autonomous multi-agent systems solving real-world education and skill monetization challenges.
fullDescription: Join over 5,000 developers across India in the AI Innovation Challenge. Participants will build multi-agent architectures that automate skill verification, portfolio indexing, or diagnostic feedback loops. Teams receive mentorship from industry AI leaders and access to free sandbox computing credits.

title: Full-Stack Frontend Developer Intern
description: Design and build modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and responsive Tailwind design systems.
fullDescription: Nexura Tech is seeking an enthusiastic Frontend Developer Intern to contribute to client-facing SaaS products. You will build modular React components, implement state management patterns, integrate with Express/REST backends, and participate in daily agile sprints.

title: Web3 Builder Hackathon & Grant Sprint
description: Construct high-speed decentralized dApps utilizing Algorand smart contracts and x402 micropayment rails.
fullDescription: The Algorand Developer Guild invites students and Web3 pioneers to build dApps with near-instant finality and minimal gas overhead. Projects focusing on student peer-to-peer escrows, ASA credentialing, or x402 payment headers will receive special judge evaluation.

title: BharatSkill Core Contributor Program
description: Contribute code to the open-source repository, review peer PRs, and earn verified contribution credentials.
fullDescription: Join the core maintenance guild of BharatSkill Nexus. Help build reusable component libraries, improve accessibility, write automated unit tests, and resolve community GitHub issues. Contributors earn on-chain badges and SkillCredits per merged PR.

title: Build x402 Gateway Feature Bounty
description: Implement an HTTP-402 micro-escrow authorization interceptor for Node.js Express APIs.
fullDescription: A targeted developer bounty to create a pluggable Express middleware package that handles HTTP 402 Payment Required headers, verifies testnet transactions, and returns authorization tokens with zero latency overhead.

title: UI/UX & Design Systems Fellowship
description: A 10-week intensive fellowship mastering interactive design, accessibility standards, and component libraries.
fullDescription: Selected fellows will work alongside senior product designers to craft intuitive interfaces for high-scale student tech products. Covers design tokens, Figma auto-layout architectures, micro-interactions, and heuristic audits.

title: Junior Data Science & Analytics Intern
description: Analyze multi-dimensional learner datasets to optimize career pathways and match algorithm performance.
fullDescription: Work directly with our analytics team to clean, explore, and visualize user progression graphs. Build predictive regression models and automated reporting dashboards to monitor learning retention.

title: Smart Contract Escrow Security Audit Bounty
description: Perform security analysis, edge-case vulnerability testing, and gas optimization on peer escrow contracts.
fullDescription: Review open-source smart contracts deployed on Algorand testnet. Identify potential re-entrancy edge-cases, state overflow risks, and submit comprehensive audit patch pull requests.

title: Junior AI/ML Research Intern
description: Collaborate on generative model evaluation, benchmark tuning, and prompt engineering optimizations.
fullDescription: DeepMind Scholars India is seeking student researchers to assist with evaluating structured model outputs, prompt distillation experiments, and fine-tuning lightweight open-weight models for edge inference.

title: Student Developer Fellowship: Emerging Tech
description: Comprehensive 12-week fellowship pairing student engineers with top tech mentors across India.
fullDescription: A flagship talent acceleration program. Fellows participate in weekly masterclasses, build real-world hackathon projects, receive 1-on-1 resume reviews, and get fast-tracked into top partner company interviews.

title: Cybersecurity Vulnerability Bounty Program
description: Inspect web endpoints, test API rate-limit defenses, and audit authentication flows.
fullDescription: Help discover and remediate security vulnerabilities across student application portals. Focus areas include OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities, CSRF token validation, and secure header configuration.

title: Design Component Kit for Hackathons Bounty
description: Craft 20+ responsive, accessible Tailwind + React UI components for student hackathon starters.
fullDescription: Create a standardized, dark-mode ready component library (modals, charts, stat cards, animated drawers) that student teams can easily copy-paste during hackathons to build stunning MVPs in hours.

title: Algorand Python SDK Open Source Contributor
description: Enhance developer SDK documentation, add code samples, and fix community GitHub issues.
fullDescription: Contribute directly to the official Python SDK repository. Add helper methods, create beginner-friendly cookbook tutorials, and test multi-signature transaction serialization on Testnet.

title: Bharat Tech Challenge: National Hackathon
description: India's premier student hackathon focused on building scalable tech for public services and education.
fullDescription: Compete against student teams from all 28 states. Build high-impact solutions across AI, decentralized value transfer, rural connectivity, and digital literacy. Grand prize includes government incubator fast-tracking.
